requests.title: Change requests
requests.emptyBody: When two bookings want the same room, the requester asks — the incumbent approves or declines, and both sides get notified.
requests.expiryNote: Requests expire 72 hours after they are sent — the requester is notified and the held booking is cancelled.
requests.askedToMove: {requester} asked {incumbent} to move a booking · opened {date}
requests.demoFallback: No request “{id}” in demo data — showing the ONCF change request.
requests.addMessageLabel: Add a message to the thread
requests.addMessagePlaceholder: Add a message to the thread…
requests.progressAria: Elapsed share of the {hours}h response window
requests.announceApproved: Booking moved to {slot}. Both parties were notified.
requests.announceDeclined: Request declined. The incumbent keeps the slot and the requester was notified.
requests.announceCancelled: Your booking was cancelled and the conflict is cleared. The incumbent keeps the slot.
requests.threadNotAvailable: Thread messages ship with v1.1 — use Inbox or email for now.
requests.incumbentBody: Approve one of {requester}’s suggested slots — we’ll move your booking automatically and notify both parties.
requests.declineReasonPlaceholder: e.g. ONCF board must stay at 14:00 — propose another day instead.
requests.waitingBody: You’ll be notified the moment they respond — usually within a few hours.
requests.approvedBody: ONCF — Steering committee now sits at {slot} · {room}. Confirmation emails went to yasmine@casatech.ma and events@oncf.ma.
requests.declinedBody: The incumbent keeps {room} at 14:00. Yasmine B. was notified
requests.declinedWithAlternatives: with alternative slots to pick from
requests.cancelledBody: Your follow-up booking was cancelled. ONCF keeps {room} at 14:00, and the pending request is withdrawn.
